full_judgment: 12. The learned Advocate for the appellants has drawn my attention to the impugned judgment of the learned District Judge and has submitted that the learned District Judge has made some observations as to the deed of gift made by the Waqif in favour of his sons and also the deed of cancellation executed and registered by the said Waqif touching the character of the land without any basis and due consideration of the documents filed by the opposite party-appellant ts and therefore, it is contended that the decision of the learned District Judge is not a proper decision of reversal and there has been a miscarriage of justice. Mr. Abdul Quayum, the learned Advocate for the appellants, contends that in a complicated matter like this without calling for any evidence of witnesses from both the sides and inviting production of some other relevant documents in support of the respective cases of the parties, he ought not to have decided the propriety and genuineness of the documents namely, deed of gift, deed of cancellation and some other documents in such a summary way and slip-shod manner and his non-observation of the provisions of law and procedure summarily as laid down in sub-section 2 of section 35 of the ordinance in deciding the appeal below has caused a serious miscarriage of justice and, as such, the impugned judgment and order of the learned District Judge cannot be sustained in law and in facts, and the same should therefore be set aside in the interest of justice.
